correctness.rationale: The 2026 theorem gives a hyperbolic L-space knot K_n with unique strong inversion for every n>=1. L-space knots are fibered, and a hyperbolic fibered knot has pseudo-Anosov monodromy. Baker--Kegel give Delta_{K_n}(t)=((t^(4n+5)+1)(t^(4n+2)+1))/((t+1)(t^2+1)). For a fibered knot this is the characteristic polynomial of the H_1 action. Each quotient factor is squarefree; the factors are coprime because a common root would satisfy z^3=1 and a power equal to -1; and primitive roots of orders 8n+10 and 8n+4 survive the removed factors. Thus the H_1 action is diagonalizable and has exact order lcm(8n+10,8n+4). The gcd is 3 exactly for n congruent to 1 mod 3, yielding the closed formula. The minimal Torelli power is exactly the order of the H_1 action.

value.rationale: The exact first-homology period is a natural invariant of a fibered-knot monodromy and gives the first positive power that enters the Torelli group. Here it is determined uniformly for every member of a newly established uniquely strongly invertible hyperbolic L-space family, with a genuine arithmetic change by a factor of three when n is 1 mod 3. This exposes a precise contrast between infinite-order pseudo-Anosov dynamics and finite homological dynamics and is not a table recomputation or parameter renaming.
